blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Object counting in videos remains a poorly characterized capability of multimodal large language models. Counting questions are included in many existing VideoQA benchmarks, but the ground-truth count distributions in these benchmarks are heavily skewed toward small values. Across the nine benchmarks we survey, the median ground-truth count is at most five, and the three most frequent values together account for between 45% and 93% of the videos. The resulting mean accuracy is then dominated by the most frequent counts; a value-dependent bias at a rare count contributes negligibly to the average and remains invisible. We introduce CountVideoBench, a benchmark of 2,600 synthetic videos covering 26 cardinalities in the interval [5, 50] (100 videos each), grouped into six clusters of consecutive counts that span the range while enabling near-neighbor comparisons. Each video contains a single class of static objects under a controlled camera motion, removing object motion and reducing recognition as confounds. We evaluate sixteen video-language models from nine architecture families in a zero-shot setting. No model exceeds 27.6% Exact Match. The dependence of accuracy on cardinality varies across models, ranging from monotonic decline to a non-monotonic peak-and-collapse pattern, which rules out increasing difficulty with cardinality as the dominant explanation of counting failure. Every model further concentrates its predictions on its own set of preferred integers, with accuracy peaks coinciding with these values and collapsing at adjacent counts. These findings highlight the need for balanced, diagnostic counting benchmarks to reliably assess this fundamental visual capability.
blocks.zh: 视频中的对象计数仍然是多式联运大语言模型的特征不佳的能力。 许多现有的VideoQA基准中都包含了计数问题,但这些基准中地面真实的计数分布严重向小值倾斜. 我们调查的9个基准中, 中位数地面真相计数最多为5个, 由此得出的平均准确性由最频繁的计数所支配;在稀有计数中依赖价值的偏差对平均值有微弱的帮助,并且仍然是无形的。 我们引入了由2,600个合成视频构成的基准,其中包含间隔[5,50](每集100个视频)的26个基本内容,分为6组连续计数,跨越范围,同时可以进行近邻比较。 每段视频都包含一个受控相机运动下的单类静态物体,去除物体运动并降低识别为错觉. 我们从9个建筑家庭的16个视频语言模型中, 在零镜头的设定中进行评估。 没有模型超过 27.6% 准确匹配. 精确度对临界值的依赖程度因模型而异,从单调衰落到非模拟峰值和碰撞模式不等,后者排除了以临界值作为计数失败主要解释的日益困难. 每个模型进一步将其预测集中在自己的一组首选整数上,精度峰值与这些值相吻合,并在相邻计数时崩溃。 这些调查结果突出表明,需要平衡、诊断性地计算基准,以可靠地评估这种基本的视觉能力。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multimodal large language models now answer a wide range of open-ended questions over images and videos.
Counting is one such task, and an informative one to isolate: it is unambiguous, has exact ground truth, and exercises detection, instance separation, and temporal aggregation jointly.
It is also a documented weakness of the underlying vision encoders.
Image-text pretrained models such as CLIP [ 20 ] encode cardinality poorly [ 18 , 29 ] , and the limitation persists in image-based vision-language models that build on these encoders [ 19 ] .
Video-language models inherit this limitation in turn, and add viewpoint change, occlusion, and temporal integration to a problem already unresolved on still images.
blocks.zh:
多式联运大型语言模型现在在图像和视频上解答了一系列广泛的开放式问题。
计数是这种任务之一,也是孤立的信息性任务:它毫不含糊,有确切的根据,并进行检测、实例分离和时间汇总。
这也是基本视觉编码器的缺陷。
CLIP[20]编码基本原理差[18,29]等图像文本预加训练的模型,这种限制在基于图像的视觉语言模型中持续存在,这些模型以这些编码器为基础[19].
视频语言模型依次继承这一限制,并将观点的改变、隔离和时间整合加进一个在静态图像上已经解决的问题。

blocks.en:
Counting in video has been studied directly [ 1 , 16 ] , and appears in broader Video-QA benchmarks [ 13 , 14 ] as one question type among many.
In both cases the count distributions concentrate most of their probability mass on a handful of small values, with long tails of rare large counts.
Accuracy averaged over such a distribution is dominated by the most frequent counts rather than reflecting counting ability across the intended range; any value-dependent bias at a rare count contributes negligibly to the mean and remains invisible.
Existing benchmarks are therefore not diagnostic of value-dependent counting behaviour.
blocks.zh:
视频中的计数被直接研究[1,16],并出现在更广泛的视频-QA基准[13,14]中,作为许多问题类型之一.
在这两种情况下,计数分布将其概率质量的大部分集中在少数小值上,而细长的尾巴是罕见的大型计数.
此类分布的平均准确性以最频繁的计数为主,而不是反映整个预定范围的计数能力;在罕见的计数中,任何依赖价值的偏差都会使平均值微乎其微,而且仍然不可见。
因此,现有的基准不能诊断基于价值的计算行为。

blocks.en:
Three findings emerge.
First, counting remains an unsolved problem even in this minimalist setting: no model exceeds 27.6 % 27.6\% Exact Match, and most stay well below this ceiling.
Second, the dependence of accuracy on cardinality varies across models: some decline monotonically, others show isolated peaks at specific cardinalities with near-zero accuracy at adjacent counts.
This rules out cardinality-induced difficulty as the dominant cause of counting failure; the variation is measurable here only because every cardinality contributes the same number of videos.
Third, every model concentrates its predictions on its own set of preferred integers, with accuracy peaks coinciding with these values and collapsing at adjacent counts.
In most models, predictions are confined to a small set of preferred values; in those with the broadest output distributions, including the two flagship proprietary ones, the concentration appears instead as local irregularities.
blocks.zh:
有三个发现。
首先,即使在这种最小化的设定中,计数仍然是一个尚未解决的问题:没有一个模型超过27.6%的27.6XX精确匹配,而且大多数模型都远远低于这个上限。
第二,精确度对基本值的依赖因模型而异:有些是单调下降,另一些是特定基本值的孤立峰,相邻计数的精确度接近零。
这排除了主要困难作为计数失败的主要原因;这种变化在这里可以衡量,只是因为每个主要因素都提供同样数量的视频。
第三,每个模型将其预测集中在自己的一组首选整数上,精确度峰值与这些值相吻合,并在相邻的计数时崩溃。
在大多数模型中,预测仅限于一小组首选值;在产出分布最广的模型中,包括两个旗舰专有的模型中,集中性反而作为当地的违规行为出现.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Video Question Answering with Multimodal LLM
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频问题与多式联运 LLM

blocks.en:
Video question answering was first addressed with task-specific architectures jointly training a video encoder, a question encoder, and a fusion module on supervised Video-QA data [ 12 , 24 , 25 ] .
The current generation is built on instruction-tuned multimodal large language models, and our fourteen open-source models span three design directions.
NVILA [ 15 ] and AdaReTaKe [ 21 ] target long-video processing through visual-token compression, learned and training-free respectively.
Qwen2.5-VL [ 3 ] , Qwen3-VL [ 2 ] and InternVL2.5 [ 4 ] extend image vision-language models to native video, through unified dynamic-resolution encoders or progressive transfer to a larger language model.
VideoLLaMA2 [ 5 ] and LLaVA-Video [ 28 ] treat video as the primary modality, through a dedicated spatio-temporal connector and video-centric instruction tuning respectively.
Two proprietary models, GPT-5.4 [ 17 ] and Gemini-3.1-pro [ 9 ] , complete the evaluation; their architectures are undisclosed but widely understood to exceed our largest open-source variants in parameter count.
blocks.zh:
视频问题回答首先通过任务特定架构联合培训视频编码器,问题编码器,以及监督视频-QA数据的聚变模块[12,24,25].
现代以指导调制的多式联运大语言模型为基础,我们的十四个开源模型跨越三个设计方向.
NVILA [15] 和 AdaReTake [21] 分别通过可视存储压缩,学习和无训练来瞄准长视频处理.
Qun2.5-VL [3], Qun3-VL [2] 和 InternVL2.5 [4] 将图像视觉语言模型扩展至原生视频,通过统一的动态解析编码器或逐渐转移到更大的语言模型.
VideoLLAMA2 [5] 和LLaVA-Video [28] 分别通过专用的时空连接器和以视频为中心的指令调制,将视频作为主要模式.
两个专有模型GPT-5.4[17]和双子座-3.1-pro[9],完成评价;它们的架构没有被披露,但被广泛理解为超过了我们在参数计数中最大的开源变体.

blocks.en: 2.2 Counting in Vision-Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 在远景-语言模型中计数

blocks.en:
Counting is a documented weakness of vision-language models built on image-text pretrained vision encoders. Paiss et al. [ 18 ] show that CLIP [ 20 ] fails on the simple task of associating an image with the prompt “a photo of N N objects” for small N N , and attribute the failure to a pretraining objective that supplies essentially no supervision for cardinality.
Zhang et al. [ 29 ] characterize a systematic quantity bias in the CLIP representation, where predicted counts concentrate on a small set of frequent values across object categories.
Qharabagh et al. [ 19 ] extend the analysis to large vision-language models and find that the encoder’s counting limitation propagates through the language-model interface, with these models failing on moderate cardinalities even on still images.
blocks.zh:
计数(Counting)是在图像文本预先训练的视觉编码器上构建的视觉语言模型的记载弱点. Paiss等人[18] 表明,CLIP[20]没有完成将图像与小NN的“N物体照片”联系起来的简单任务,并且将失败归因于基本上不为基本性提供监督的预先训练目标。
张等. [29] 描述的是CLIP表示法中系统性的数量偏差,其中预测的计数集中于不同对象类别的少量频繁值.
Qharabagh等人[19] 将分析扩展到大型视觉语言模型,发现编码器的计数限制通过语言模型界面传播,这些模型甚至对于静态图像来说都失败了。

blocks.en: Video-language models inherit this constraint by construction: their vision encoders (CLIP, SigLIP [ 27 ] , InternViT [ 4 ] , and other image-text pretrained ViTs) were trained on large-scale image-text pairs that supply essentially no supervision for cardinality.
blocks.zh: 视频语言模型通过构建继承了这一限制:他们的视觉编码器(CLIP,SigLIP [27],InternViT [4],以及其他图像文本预训ViTs)接受了大规模图像文本对子的培训,这些对子基本上没有为主线提供监管.

blocks.en:
Temporal aggregation therefore operates on features that already encode cardinality poorly at the frame level, and adds viewpoint changes, partial occlusion, and temporal integration to a problem that is unresolved on still images.
Closest to our setting, VLMCountBench [ 10 ] isolates counting on still images using minimal geometric shapes under strict variable control, and reports reliable counting when a single shape type is present.
We transpose this minimalist philosophy to video and vary cardinality rather than compositional complexity, and find that the single-class regime does not remain reliable over a range extending to fifty.
The benchmarks through which counting in video is currently evaluated are reviewed next.
blocks.zh:
因此,时间汇总的特性在帧一级已经编码不足,并将观点变化、部分隔离和时间整合加进一个在静态图像上尚未解决的问题。
最接近我们的设定,VLMCount Bench [10] 隔离了使用严格可变控制下最小几何形状的静态图像,并在存在单一形状类型时报告可靠的计数.
我们把这种最小主义哲学移植到录像中, 并改变主要性, 而不是构成的复杂性, 并且发现, 单一阶级制度在50个范围内并不可靠。
接下来将审查目前用来评价录像中计数的基准。

blocks.en: 2.3 Counting Benchmarks in Video
blocks.zh: 2.3 录像中的计数基准

blocks.en: Counting questions appear in a number of video benchmarks. Four of them are recurrent reference points in the recent counting literature.
blocks.zh: 计数问题出现在一些视频基准中. 其中四个是近期计数文献中反复出现的参考点.

blocks.en: MVBench [ 13 ] is a comprehensive video-understanding benchmark spanning twenty perception and reasoning tasks; counting appears as multiple-choice sub-tasks with object and action variants over a small set of candidate answers.
blocks.zh: MV Bench [13]是一个涵盖20个感知和推理任务的综合视频理解基准;计数以多选择子任务出现,对象和行动变体在一小组候选答案之上.

blocks.en:
VideoCount [ 1 ] casts counting in video as an open-world task: a system receives a text description or a visual exemplar of the target class and must enumerate the unique instances appearing in the clip.
The benchmark unifies subsets of the tracking datasets TAO [ 6 ] and MOT20 [ 7 ] with scientific footage of penguins and metal-alloy crystallization.
It does report results by count range, but only across these sub-benchmarks (TAO: 1 1 – 10 10 ; MOT20: 80 80 – 1203 1203 ; Science: 10 10 – 154 154 ): strata separated by orders of magnitude cannot reveal value-dependent behavior between consecutive cardinalities.
blocks.zh:
VideoCount [1] 将计数在视频中设定为开放世界的任务:一个系统收到一个文本描述或目标类的视觉实例,必须列举片段中出现的独特实例.
基准统一了跟踪数据集TAO[6]和MOT20[7]的子集,并附有企鹅和金属合金结晶的科学镜头.
它确实按照计数范围报告结果,但只能跨越这些次基准(TAO:1 – 10 10;MOT20:80 – 1203 1203;Science:10 – 154 154 ):按数量级划分的阶层无法显示连续的多数之间依赖价值的行为.

blocks.en:
CG-AV-Counting [ 16 ] targets long-form videos with clue-grounded multimodal queries; counting targets cover events, objects, and attributes, and queries combine audio-only, visual-only, and joint audio-visual formats.
VCBench [ 14 ] introduces streaming counting as a probe for spatio-temporal state maintenance, decomposing the task into object and event variants (currently visible instances, cumulative unique identities, instantaneous actions, and complete activity cycles) and querying the model at multiple points along the timeline.
blocks.zh:
CG-AV-Counting [16] 以基于线索的多模式查询的长式视频为目标;计数目标覆盖事件,对象,属性,以及查询结合了唯声,唯视觉,联合视听格式.
VCBench [14]引入流线计作为spatio-时态维护的探针,将任务分解为对象和事件变体(目前可见实例,累积的独特身份,瞬间动作,以及完整的活动周期),并在时间线上多个点查询模型.

blocks.en: Counting also appears as one question type among many in NExT-QA [ 22 ] , TGIF-QA [ 11 ] , and Video-MME [ 8 ] , and as a derived sub-task in the synthetic-video benchmarks CLEVRER [ 26 ] and VLM4D [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 在NExT-QA[22]、TGIF-QA[11]和Video-MME[8]中,计数也作为一个问题类型出现,并作为合成-视频基准CLEVRER[26]和VLM4D[30]中的一个衍生子任务出现。

blocks.en:
Despite this diversity, none of these benchmarks is specifically designed for diagnostic evaluation of object-instance counting across a broad and balanced range of cardinalities.
We quantify this gap in the next section, where we measure the imbalance in the count distribution of existing benchmarks and motivate the design of CountVideoBench against it.
blocks.zh:
尽管存在这种多样性,但这些基准中没有一个是专门用来对广泛和均衡的基本要素的物体计数进行诊断性评价的。
我们在下一节中量化了这一差距,其中我们衡量了现有基准的计数分配的不平衡,并激励了Bench伯爵的设计。

blocks.en: 3 Empirical Analysis of Benchmark Biases
blocks.zh: 3 基准基准基准的经验分析

blocks.en:
Accuracy on a counting benchmark is a weighted average over the cardinalities present in the data.
When the count distribution is concentrated on a small number of values, the resulting score reflects behavior on those values rather than counting ability across the intended range. A model that counts well on the dominant cardinalities and poorly elsewhere can yield the same aggregate score as one with balanced behavior.
Counting failures in video-language models need not be uniform along the cardinality axis: a model may concentrate predictions on a small set of preferred values, or exhibit accuracy that varies non-monotonically with the true count.
Detecting such patterns therefore requires each cardinality of interest to receive enough videos for a stable per-value estimate.
This fails when most counts appear only once or twice and most videos sit on a handful of small values.
blocks.zh:
计算基准的准确性是数据中基本值的加权平均数。
当计数分布集中在少数值上时,产生的分数反映了这些值的行为,而不是在预定范围内计算能力. 一个很好地依赖主要核心且在别处差强人意的模型可以得出与行为平衡相同的总分。
盘点视频语言模型的失败不一定在主轴上是统一的:一个模型可能把预测集中在一小组首选值上,或者显示准确度与真实的计数不同。
因此,要检测这种模式,每一大利益方都必须收到足够的录像,以便按价值作出稳定的估计。
当大多数数只出现一次或两次,而大多数视频只停留在少数小数值上时,则失败。

blocks.en:
To quantify the imbalance, we report for each benchmark its Top-3 share : the proportion of videos whose ground-truth count falls within the three most frequent cardinalities.
The statistic is independent of the count range and number of distinct values, and varies from 3 / k 3/k on a strictly uniform benchmark with k k distinct counts to 100 % 100\% on one whose mass collapses onto three values.
Table 1 reports the Top-3 share, the count range, the number of distinct counts, and the median with interquartile range for nine existing video benchmarks that include counting questions.
Figure 2 plots three representative ones; all nine plus ours appear in Appendix Fig. 6 .
All three share a heavy concentration of probability mass on counts below ten, with Top-3 shares between 45.3% (VCBench [ 14 ] ) and 93.1% (VideoCount [ 1 ] ).
VideoCount, CG-AV-Counting [ 16 ] , and VCBench additionally exhibit long tails of rare large counts with negligible statistical weight.
MVBench [ 13 ] is capped at 9 and exhibits strong mass concentration even within this short range, with the single value 3 3 accounting for 33 % 33\% of the benchmark.
Across all nine benchmarks in Table 1 , the median ground-truth count is at most five and the Top-3 share never falls below 45 % 45\% .

CountVideoBench is designed to address this constraint. Section 4 describes its construction in detail; for the present analysis the relevant feature is that the benchmark distributes 2,600 2{,}600 videos uniformly over 26 26 cardinalities in the range [ 5 , 50 ] [5,50] , with 100 100 videos per cardinality.
The resulting Top-3 share is 11.5 % 11.5\% , matching the 3 / 26 ≈ 11.5 % 3/26\approx 11.5\% lower bound for a uniform design over 26 26 cardinalities, and substantially below every benchmark in Table 1 .
Metrics computed on this distribution therefore weight every cardinality equally, and the value-dependent biases analysed in Section 6.3 remain visible rather than absorbed into a few dominant counts.
blocks.zh:
计数视频 法官职位旨在解决这一制约因素。 第4节详细介绍了其构建情况;在本分析中,相关特征是,基准分发的视频在[5、50][5、50]范围内的26个主要部分中统一超过2 600 2{、}600个,每个主要部分100个。

blocks.en: 4 CountVideoBench Dataset
blocks.zh: 4 贝许伯爵数据集

blocks.en: 4.1 Design Principles
blocks.zh: 4.1 设计原则

blocks.en: CountVideoBench follows two design principles addressing the limitations of Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 计数视频 法官团遵循两项设计原则,处理第3节的局限性。

blocks.en:
The first principle is distributional balance .
Each cardinality used for evaluation is represented by the same number of videos.
Aggregate metrics therefore weight every count equally.
The resulting Top-3 share (last row of Table 1 ) is approximately four times smaller than that of the most balanced existing benchmark in our comparison.
blocks.zh:
第一个原则是分配平衡。
用于评价的每一个要点都以同样数量的视频为代表。
因此,综合度量衡对每个计数都具有同等的权重。
由此得出的Top-3份额(表1最后一行)大约比我们比较中最平衡的现有基准少四倍。

blocks.en:
The second principle is isolation from recognition .
Counting in natural video entangles detection, classification, instance separation, and temporal aggregation. To diagnose counting itself, we reduce recognition and motion as confounds:
each video contains a single class of simple geometric objects, and objects are static while the camera moves.
A model is therefore evaluated on enumerating instances of an already-identified class, and failures in this setting are unlikely to stem primarily from recognition or motion.
blocks.zh:
第二项原则是脱离承认。
计算在自然视频的缠绕检测,分类,实例分离,和时间聚合中. 为了判断自己,我们减少认知和运动,认为这令人困惑:
每个视频包含一个单一的几何类简单对象,物体在相机移动时是静止的.
因此,在列举已查明的类别实例时评价一个模式,在此情况下的失败不太可能主要产生于承认或动议。

blocks.en: 4.2 Anchor-Neighborhood Structure
blocks.zh: 4.2 锚-邻结构

blocks.en:
The cardinality sampling is shaped by two requirements.
The benchmark should span more than an order of magnitude in cardinality, and support bias detection through near-neighbor comparisons where the task and scene remain otherwise comparable.
A continuous uniform distribution over [ 5 , 50 ] [5,50] would satisfy both requirements but would require 46 × 100 = 4,600 46\times 100=4{,}600 videos, beyond our rendering budget.
We adopt an anchor-neighborhood structure that preserves the range while reducing the rendering cost, and concentrates sampling where neighbour comparisons are informative.
blocks.zh:
主要取样由两项要求决定。
基准的范围应超过基本程度的大小,并在任务和场景仍具有可比性的地方,通过近邻比较,支持发现偏差。
在[5,50][5,50]上持续统一分发将满足这两项要求,但需要46×100=4,600 46\times 100=4{,}600视频,超出我们的制作预算。
我们采用锚-邻结构,既保留范围,又降低渲染成本,并将取样集中在邻居比较信息丰富的地方。

blocks.en:
Six anchor cardinalities are selected, 𝒜 = { 5 , 10 , 20 , 30 , 40 , 50 } \mathcal{A}=\{5,10,20,30,40,50\} .
For each anchor n ∈ 𝒜 n\in\mathcal{A} , the five consecutive cardinalities { n − 2 , n − 1 , n , n + 1 , n + 2 } \{n-2,n-1,n,n+1,n+2\} are included; the union is bounded to [ 5 , 50 ] [5,50] .
The four interior anchors ( 10 10 , 20 20 , 30 30 , 40 40 ) thus contribute five cardinalities each; the two edge anchors ( 5 5 and 50 50 ) lose two values to truncation and contribute three each.
The benchmark covers 26 26 distinct cardinalities, one hundred videos each, yielding 2,600 2{,}600 videos in total. We refer to each anchor and its neighbours as a cluster .
blocks.zh:
选择了6个主播,A={5,10,20,30,40,50}\mathcal{A=5,10,20,30,40,50}.
对每个主播 n {A\in\ mathcal{A} , 连续五个主播 {n − 2, n − 1, n + 1, n + 1, n + 2 }} {{{n-2,n-1,n,n+1,n+2} } 包括 ; 结合 以 [5, 50] [5,50] 为限 。
4个内锚(10个10个,20个20个,30个30个,40个40个)因此各贡献5个骨干;2个边锚(5个5个和50个50个)损失2个值以截断,每个贡献3个.
基准涵盖26个不同的基本内容,每部100个录像,总共产生2 600 2{,}600个录像。 我们把每个锚及其邻国称为一组。

blocks.en:
Within each cluster, the five neighboring cardinalities share the same task and differ only by small amounts.
Comparing accuracy across a cluster therefore probes model behavior under near-identical inputs, and reveals whether predictions track the ground truth or concentrate at specific values: at the anchor, elsewhere in the cluster, or outside.
Dense sampling within each cluster provides the local resolution to read these patterns.
blocks.zh:
在每一组中,五个邻近的主要群体分担着同样的任务,只有少量不同。
因此,对一个集群的准确性进行比较,在近乎相同的输入下探索模型行为,并揭示预测是跟踪地面真相,还是集中在特定值上:锚点、集群的其他地方或外部。
每个组群内的密集采样提供了局部分辨率来读取这些图案.

blocks.en: 4.3 Generation Pipeline and Composition
blocks.zh: 4.3 生成管道和组成

blocks.en: Videos are generated procedurally in Blender, each scene fully determined by a single random seed. Each video lasts five seconds at 30 30 frames per second ( 150 150 frames) and is rendered at 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 . Figure 1 shows example frames at three cardinalities.
blocks.zh: 视频在Blender中程序生成,每个场景完全由一个单一随机种子决定. 每段视频持续5秒,每秒30帧(150帧150帧),于1920×10801920\times渲染. 1080 (英语). 图1显示三个要点的示例框架。

blocks.en:
Object classes. The benchmark uses ten object classes, crossing two shapes, cube and sphere, with five colors: red, blue, green, yellow, and purple (Figure 1 ).
Each video contains a single class, so the counting question admits a unique correct answer.
The colors are mutually distinguishable against the white background and avoid chromatic adjacencies (e.g. orange/yellow, cyan/blue) that could conflate counting with color identification. Both shapes and colors remain identifiable at small angular sizes.
blocks.zh:
对象类. 基准使用十个对象类,跨越两个形状,立方体和球体,有五色:红,蓝,绿,黄,紫(图1).
每段视频包含一个单一的类,因此计数问题承认一个独特的正确答案.
颜色与白色背景是可相互区分的,并避免染色的附着物(如橙色/黄色,青色/蓝色)可以将计数与颜色识别混为一谈. 形状和颜色都以小角大小仍然可以识别.

blocks.en:
Scene and camera. The background is uniform white overlaid with a regular line pattern, and object surfaces carry a low-amplitude procedural noise that produces faint per-instance texture variations. These choices address a difficulty at high density: perfectly identical, densely packed objects visually merge and become hard to enumerate even to a human observer. The line pattern provides a spatial reference and the surface noise breaks visual symmetry between adjacent instances, without altering color or shape identification.
Lighting is uniform and identical across all videos.
Objects are placed at random positions within a bounded region of the ground plane; a minimum-distance constraint combined with Blender’s collision system prevents overlap (Appendix B ).
The camera rotates in place, with orientation changes drawn within bounded angular ranges.
The placement bounds and rotation range are chosen so that every object is visible in at least some frames, keeping the count attainable, while no single frame is guaranteed to show all N N at once: 83.0 % 83.0\% of videos contain at least one object leaving the field of view, and on average 3.29 3.29 objects per video fall outside the frame at some point during the clip.
The task therefore requires integrating partial views over time to avoid omissions and double counts.
blocks.zh:
场景和相机。 背景为统一白色,带有正线图案,物体表面带有低照率的程序噪声,产生微弱的每英寸纹理变异. 这些选择在高密度时解决了一个难题:完全相同、包裹密集的物体在视觉上合并,甚至对人类观察员来说也变得难以列举。 线形图案提供了一个空间参考,表面噪声打破了相邻实例之间的视觉对称,而不改变颜色或形状识别.
在所有视频中,灯光是统一的和相同的。
物体被放在地面平面的限定区域内的随机位置上;最低距离的限制与Blender的碰撞系统相结合,可以防止重叠(附录B )。
相机旋转就位,方向变化在定界角范围内.
选择放置界限和旋转范围是为了让每个对象至少在一些帧中可见,保持计数可实现,而不能保证单个帧一次显示所有的N N :83.0% 83.0QQ的视频至少包含一个离开视域的对象,在剪辑期间的某个时间,每个视频平均3.29 3.29个对象掉在帧外.
因此,这项任务需要逐渐综合部分意见,以避免遗漏和双重计算。

blocks.en:
Composition. Within each cardinality, the ten object classes are equally represented, with exactly ten videos per (shape, color) class. The random seed governing object positions and the camera trajectory is drawn independently for each video.
Each video is paired with a single question–answer pair, generated automatically from the scene metadata, which ensures exact ground-truth availability without any human annotation step.
blocks.zh:
组成. 在每个核心类中,十个对象类具有同等代表性,每个类(形状,颜色)有10个录像。 随机的种子支配对象位置和相机轨迹对每个视频独立绘制.
每个视频都配对一个单一的问答对,自动从场景元数据中产生,确保准确的地面真实提供,而无需任何人类注释步骤.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Models and Inference
blocks.zh: 5.1 模型和推论

blocks.en:
On CountVideoBench, we evaluate sixteen video-language models drawn from nine architecture families.
Seven of these families are open-source: AdaReTaKe [ 21 ] , LLaVA-Video [ 28 ] , NVILA [ 15 ] , Qwen2.5-VL [ 3 ] , Qwen3-VL [ 2 ] , VideoLLaMA2 [ 5 ] , and InternVL2.5 [ 4 ] .
Each family contributes a lightweight variant ( 7 7 – 8 8 B parameters) and a full-scale variant ( 15 15 – 78 78 B).
This pairing enables comparing counting behavior across scale within a fixed architecture.
Two proprietary models, GPT-5.4 [ 17 ] and Gemini-3.1-pro [ 9 ] , are included only in their flagship configuration, as high-capacity reference points; smaller variants lack the public documentation needed for a controlled scale comparison.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了来自九个建筑家族的16个视频语言模型。
其中7个家庭是开放来源的: AdaReTake [21], LLaVA-Video [28], NVILA [15], Quen2.5-VL [3], Quen3-VL [2], VideoLaMA2 [5], 和 InternVL2.5 [4].
每个家族贡献一个轻量级变体(7 7– 8 8 B参数)和一个全尺寸变体(15 15–78 78 B).
这种配对可以比较固定架构内跨尺度的计数行为.
两个专有型号GPT-5.4 [17] 和双子座-3.1-pro [9] 仅包含在它们的旗舰配置中,因为容量较大的参考点;较小的变体缺乏控制尺度比较所需的公开文件.

blocks.en:
All models are evaluated zero-shot on ten frames sampled uniformly from each clip, with no in-context examples and no fine-tuning on counting data.
A single prompt is used: “How many [color] [shape]s are in this video?” , with [color] and [shape] filled from the scene metadata.
The decoding budget is set to max_tokens = 1024 =1024 for all models.
Responses are typically short natural-language sentences containing the predicted count, occasionally with a brief justification.
blocks.zh:
所有模型在从每个剪辑中统一抽取的10个帧上都进行了零镜头评价,没有内文实例,也没有对计数数据进行微调.
使用一个提示: “这段录像中有多少[颜色][形状]?”
解码预算设定为最大_tokens = 1024 = 1024 所有模型.
答复一般是含有预测数的自然语言短句,偶尔有简短的理由。

blocks.en:
Model outputs are free-form text and do not always consist of a single integer.
We extract the predicted count from each response with a lightweight model parser (Qwen2.5-7B [ 23 ] ), returning the integer when one can be unambiguously identified and NaN otherwise. The full extracted CSV is then verified manually.
Predictions tagged NaN represent non-responses (refusals, qualitative answers such as “many” , generations that do not commit to a numerical value, or ambiguous outputs containing multiple incompatible integers) and are treated separately in the metrics defined below.
blocks.zh:
模型输出是自由形式的文本,并不总是由一个整数组成.
我们用一个轻量级模型解析器(Quen2.5-7B [23])从每个响应中提取预测数,当可以明确识别时返回整数,否则则返回NaN。 然后手动验证完整的提取的CSV.

Exact Match measures strict numerical correctness.
Tolerance Accuracy captures approximate correctness within a value-dependent margin.

blocks.en: 6.1 Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 6.1 总体业绩

blocks.en: Table 2 reports overall performance and output diversity on CountVideoBench.
blocks.zh: 表2报告了本奇伯爵的总体业绩和产出多样性。

blocks.en:
Exact Match. Three models cluster at the top of the Exact Match (EM) column within two points of each other: Gemini-3.1-pro at 27.6 % 27.6\% , LLaVA-Video-7B at 26.8 % 26.8\% , and GPT-5.4 at 25.7 % 25.7\% (all results use a single prompt formulation fixed in advance, Section 5 ).
No other model exceeds 23 % 23\% ; five of sixteen stay below 10 % 10\% .
Even on a benchmark with a single object class, static instances, and exact ground truth, agreement with the true cardinality remains uncommon.
One model behaves degenerately: VideoLLaMA2-7B answers only 1.2 % 1.2\% of videos, collapsing its EM to 0.1 % 0.1\% .
Inspection shows that the model most often returns a refusal or a sentence without a count rather than a wrong number, indicating an instruction-following failure rather than a counting failure.

blocks.en:
Human reference. On a subset of 104 104 videos, twenty participants viewing the same ten sampled frames as the models reach 90.8 % 90.8\% mean EM against 26.9 % 26.9\% for the best models, with a gradual decline across cardinality and no peak-and-collapse structure.
The scenes are countable; the low model scores reflect limitations of current approaches (Appendix C ).

Within-family scaling is inconsistent. The two proprietary models, Gemini-3.1-pro and GPT-5.4, place first and third on EM, and both are widely understood to operate well beyond the 72 72 to 78 78 B range of our largest
open-source variants, which would invite a scale-based reading of their lead.
The within-family numbers caution against it. Across the seven open-source families, four place the larger variant ahead by 2 2 to 6 6 points, two of them in regimes where both variants stay below 6 % 6\% , two differ by less than two points, and one (LLaVA-Video) places the 7 7 B variant ahead by 12.7 12.7 . The largest within-family gap therefore goes in the inverse-scaling direction, and the most accurate open-source model on EM is the 7 7 B variant of its family.

Magnitude metrics do not capture prediction structure. MAE and RMSE, computed over answered videos, summarize how far predictions fall from the truth but not how they are distributed: LLaVA-Video-7B and NVILA-15B share an RMSE of 6.1 6.1 and differ by 0.2 0.2 in MAE, yet differ by a factor of two in EM ( 26.8 % 26.8\% against 12.5 % 12.5\% ) and in concentration ( PP \mathrm{PP} 8.0 8.0 against 14.3 14.3 ).
They complement EM without exposing the preferred-value concentration and adjacent-cardinality collapses of Section 6.3 .
blocks.zh:
放大度测量不能捕捉预测结构. MAE和RMSE, 计算过多的解答视频, 总结了预测离真相还有多远, 而不是如何分布: LLaVA-Video-7B和NVILA-15B的RMSE为6.1, 在MAE中是0.2. 0.2, 但是在EM(26.8% 26.8+%, 12.5% 12.5+%)和浓度(PP \mathrm{PP} 8.0 8.0, 在14.3 14.3)中是两个系数的不同。
它们补充了EM,而不暴露第6.3节的首选价值浓度和相邻心肌崩溃。

blocks.en:
Errors are typically near misses. The gap between EM and Acc@10% is substantial for most models, and the ranking on the relaxed metric differs from the strict one.
GPT-5.4 stands out at 70.5 % 70.5\% , nearly 45 45 points above its own EM and more than 14 14 points ahead of the next model.
Eleven of the sixteen models gain more than 13 13 points under tolerance.
In applications tolerating a small relative error, such as crowd-level summaries, several models reach usable accuracy.
Acc@10% does not rescue every model, however: four stay below 10 % 10\% even with the relaxed criterion (Table 2 ). For VideoLLaMA2-7B this reflects its near-zero coverage; for the three others, errors are large in relative magnitude.
blocks.zh:
错误通常接近错失 。 对大多数模型来说,EM和Acc@10%之间的差距很大,对放松度量的排名不同于严格的。
GPT-5.4以70.5%70.5%的成绩突出,比自己的EM高出近45分,比下一个模型提前14分以上.

blocks.en:
Two response policies behind Exact Match. Coverage varies more widely across models than either accuracy measure, and reveals two distinct response policies.
Eight models answer at least 97 % 97\% of videos and effectively never abstain; abstention rises steadily across the other eight, from under 9 % 9\% for AdaReTaKe-7B to half the benchmark for InternVL2.5-78B, and to near-totality for the degenerate VideoLLaMA2-7B.
Two regimes therefore coexist behind the Exact Match column. Systematic answering, with predictions that are often wrong but always present, is exemplified by NVILA-8B at 100 % 100\% Coverage and 6.6 % 6.6\% Exact Match.
Selective abstention, with comparatively higher per-answered accuracy, is exemplified by LLaVA-Video-72B at 69.1 % 69.1\% Coverage and 14.1 % 14.1\% Exact Match.
Comparing models on Exact Match alone conflates these regimes, and Section 6.2 shows that abstention is structured along the cardinality axis rather than uniform.
blocks.zh:
Exact Match背后的两个响应政策. 不同模型的涵盖范围比准确度的衡量要大,并揭示出两种不同的应对政策。
8个模型至少回答97%的97%的视频,而且实际上从未弃权;其他8个模型的弃权率稳步上升,从9 %的9 %的AdaReTake-7B上升到了InternVL2.5-78B基准的一半,而堕落的VideoLLaMA2-7B则接近完全.
因此,在Exact Match专栏后面存在两种制度。 NVILA-8B以100%的100%的覆盖率和6.6%的6.6%的精确匹配率为例。
LLaVA-Video-72B以69.1%的覆盖率和14.1%的精确比对为例,选择性弃权,每答准确率相对较高。
仅用精确匹配模型来比较这些制度,而第6.2节显示,弃权是按主要轴线而不是统一的。

blocks.en: 6.2 Behavior Across the Cardinality Range
blocks.zh: 6.2 跨越主教区的行为

blocks.en: The aggregate metrics of Section 6.1 hide a strong dependence of model behavior on the target cardinality. Figure 3 plots Coverage by ground-truth count, and Figure 4 reports the per-cardinality Exact Match.
blocks.zh: 第6.1节的总尺度掩盖了模型行为对目标基本性的强烈依赖。 图3 以地面真实计数进行覆盖,图4则报告人心精确匹配.

blocks.en:
Coverage by cardinality. The compared models follow three behavior patterns in Figure 3 .
The first is full or near-full Coverage across the entire range.
Among the eight models with aggregate Coverage above 97 % 97\% in Table 2 , five (NVILA-8B, NVILA-15B, Qwen3-VL-8B, GPT-5.4, and LLaVA-Video-7B) stay at or above 95 % 95\% on every cardinality, and two more (InternVL2.5-8B and Gemini-3.1-pro) drop slightly on the upper range but remain above 85 % 85\% throughout.
AdaReTaKe-72B is the borderline case: at near full Coverage up to n = 42 n=42 , it falls to 79 % 79\% at n = 50 n=50 .
The second pattern is a cardinality-dependent decline: seven models show this, six ending below 50 % 50\% Coverage at n = 50 n=50 and Qwen3-VL-32B ending at 61 % 61\% .
The onset varies widely from one model to the next: LLaVA-Video-72B remains near full Coverage until n = 22 n=22 before falling to 2 % 2\% at n = 50 n=50 , while InternVL2.5-78B declines from n = 6 n=6 onward, reaching 18 % 18\% at n = 50 n=50 , and Qwen3-VL-32B drops abruptly between n = 12 n=12 ( 95 % 95\% ) and n = 18 n=18 ( 59 % 59\% ) before fluctuating between 51 % 51\% and 83 % 83\% .
The third pattern is a broad refusal to engage with the task: VideoLLaMA2-7B answers 16 % 16\% of videos at n = 5 n=5 and essentially none above.

blocks.en:
Asymmetric dissociation of Coverage and Exact Match. Read together, Figures 3 and 4 show that the two metrics capture complementary failure modes (no answer versus wrong answers) and that this dissociation is asymmetric: EM can collapse while Coverage stays high, but no model preserves EM by selectively abstaining on hard cardinalities.
Qwen3-VL-8B answers every video at every cardinality while its EM drops to exactly zero at eleven of the twenty-six cardinalities: the model keeps answering, and answers wrong.
The opposite dissociation (Coverage dropping while EM is sustained by selective abstention on hard cases) does not occur in our evaluation.
LLaVA-Video-72B and InternVL2.5-78B both see Coverage and EM collapse jointly on the upper range: at n = 50 n=50 , LLaVA-Video-72B answers 2 % 2\% of the videos and none correctly, InternVL2.5-78B answers 18 % 18\% with EM 1 % 1\% .
The aggregate Coverage reported in Table 2 therefore captures a response policy rather than an epistemic calibration: high Coverage identifies models that always answer, but low Coverage does not identify models that abstain when they would have been wrong.
blocks.zh:
覆盖和精确匹配的不对称分离. 一起阅读,图3和图4显示,这两个度量法捕捉到互补的失败模式(无答案与错误的答案),这种脱节是不对称的:EM可以在覆盖保持高水平时崩溃,但没有任何模型通过选择性地弃权硬性核心来维护EM.
Qune3-VL-8B在每条主线上回答每段视频,而它的EM则在26个主线中的11个完全下降到零:模型不断回答,回答错误.
我们的评价中并没有出现相反的脱离关系(在紧急事件有选择地弃权的情况下,紧急事件下降)。
LLaVA-Video-72B和InternVL2.5-78B都可以看到覆盖率和EM崩溃率在上方:在n=50n=50时,LLaVA-Video-72B回答2%的视频2\%,没有正确,InternVL2.5-78B回答18% 18\%,EM1%的1\%.
因此,表2中报告的总覆盖率反映的是一种反应政策,而不是感官校准:高覆盖率确定的模式总是答案,但低覆盖率确定的模式不会在错误时弃权。

blocks.en:
Exact Match by cardinality. Counting larger sets is intuitively harder than counting small ones; one would therefore expect EM to decay with cardinality.
Figure 4 only partially supports this expectation.
A first group of models does decline as expected, with local irregularities but no large peaks: GPT-5.4 falls from 95 % 95\% at n = 5 n=5 to 7 % 7\% at n = 20 n=20 and stays below 20 % 20\% on most of the upper range, Gemini-3.1-pro falls from 93 % 93\% at n = 5 n=5 to below 20 % 20\% for every n ≥ 18 n\geq 18 , and similar drops are observed for InternVL2.5-78B, LLaVA-Video-72B, and Qwen3-VL-32B.
The remaining models are non-monotonic, with pronounced peaks at specific cardinalities and near-zero accuracy at adjacent counts: LLaVA-Video-7B reaches EM 95 % 95\% at n = 20 n=20 , 43 % 43\% at n = 30 n=30 , and 94 % 94\% at n = 50 n=50 ; AdaReTaKe-72B peaks at 73 % 73\% at n = 10 n=10 and 78 % 78\% at n = 20 n=20 ; InternVL2.5-8B reaches EM between 84 % 84\% and 91 % 91\% at n ∈ { 10 , 20 , 30 } n\in\{10,20,30\} and collapses to zero at every intermediate cardinality except n = 12 n=12 ( 52 % 52\% ); Qwen3-VL-8B peaks at 81 % 81\% at n = 30 n=30 with markedly lower values on either side.
The two NVILA variants share this peak-and-collapse structure, with peaks on the upper anchors { 30 , 40 , 50 } \{30,40,50\} , producing an apparent upward trend when only endpoints are compared.
blocks.zh:
精准匹配 由关键。 比起小的几套,计算更大的几套更直观地困难;因此,人们期望EM会随着临界值而衰败。
图4仅部分证实了这一期望。
第一批型号确实如预期的那样下降,但当地没有出现大峰:GPT-5.4从95% 95% = n = 5 n = 5 降至7% 7% = n = 20 n = 20 = 20 = 20,双子座3.1-pro从93% = n = 5 n = 5 降至20% = 20 = 18 n\ geq 18, InternVL2.5-78B、LLaVA-Video-72B和Quen3-VL-32B也有类似的下降。
其余的模型是非模态的,在特定的临界点有显著的峰值,在相邻的计数中则有接近零的精确度: LLaVA-Video-7B在n=20 n=20时达到EM 95% 95%,在n=30 n=30时达到43 % 94%;在n=50 n=50时达到94% 94%;AdaReTake-72B在73% 73 73\%在n=10 n=10 和78 % 78 78\%在n=20 n=20;InternVL2.5-8B在n=84% 84 84\%和91 % 91\%在n=10,20,30 30\})之间达到EM,除n=12 n=12(52\%);在n=30时达到81% 81\%在n=30 n=30,每方的数值明显较低。
两种NVILA变体共同拥有这种峰值和折叠结构,上锚的峰值为{30,40,50}}\{30,40,50\},在仅比较端点时产生明显的上升趋势.

blocks.en:
EM therefore does not follow one difficulty-driven trajectory: models with comparable aggregate EM either decline monotonically or oscillate along the cardinality axis. Across the non-monotonic group, the peak-and-collapse structure dominates: isolated peaks at specific cardinalities, with near-zero accuracy at adjacent counts.
AdaReTaKe-7B illustrates this: 81 % 81\% at n = 20 n=20 , 39 % 39\% at n = 30 n=30 , near zero on adjacent cardinalities. Peak locations vary across models, but the structure itself is shared.
It cannot be explained by cardinality-as-difficulty alone, which Section 6.3 addresses by analysing prediction distributions.
blocks.zh:
因此,EM不遵循一个困难驱动的轨迹:具有可比总EM的模型要么单调下降,要么沿主轴斜缩下降。 在整个非摩诺体组中,峰值和折叠结构占主导地位:特定基数的孤立峰值,相邻计数的精确度接近零.
AdaReTaKe-7B说明了这一点:81%的81\%在n=20n=20,39%的39\%在n=30n=30,在相邻的枢轴上接近零. 峰的位置因模型而异,但结构本身是共享的.
它不能仅以基本困难来解释,第6.3节通过分析预测分布来阐述这一点。

blocks.en: 6.3 Distributional Biases in Model Predictions
blocks.zh: 6.3 模型预测中的分布比喻

blocks.en:
EM peaks coincide with preferred values. The peak-and-collapse structure of Exact Match noted at the end of Section 6.2 admits a natural reading: the model would be locally competent, accurate at some cardinalities and weak at adjacent ones.
The distribution of predictions rules out this reading. LLaVA-Video-7B provides the clearest case.
Figure 5 (a) shows the histogram of its predicted counts across the 2,600 2{,}600 videos: sixteen integer values appear at all, and five of them concentrate 80 % 80\% of the mass: 20 20 (predicted 716 716 times), 30 30 ( 628 628 ), 50 50 ( 373 373 ), 12 12 ( 224 224 ), and 10 10 ( 124 124 ).
The Exact Match peaks of Figure 4 line up with four of these five preferred values: EM is 95 % 95\% at n = 20 n=20 , 43 % 43\% at n = 30 n=30 , 94 % 94\% at n = 50 n=50 , and 87 % 87\% at n = 12 n=12 .
The fifth, 10 10 , behaves differently: the value 10 10 is predicted 124 124 times across the benchmark, but only 49 49 of those predictions occur at n = 10 n=10 , so EM at n = 10 n=10 stays at 49 % 49\% .
At every cardinality outside the preferred set the model falls back on the closest preferred value, which is incorrect by construction; the value 40 40 is never predicted across the entire benchmark, and EM at n = 40 n=40 is consequently 0 % 0\% .
The Exact Match peaks therefore mark coincidences between a small, model-specific set of preferred answers and the ground-truth value, rather than cardinalities at which the model counts well.
The same peak-and-collapse structure appears in Figure 4 for AdaReTaKe-7B, InternVL2.5-8B, and NVILA-8B, each with its own preferred set.
blocks.zh:
EM峰值与首选值一致. 第6.2节结尾处注意到的Exact Match的峰值-和-缩合结构承认自然读数:该模型将具有当地能力,在一些基本成分上准确,在相邻的成分上弱。
预测的分布排除了这种阅读. LLaVA-Video-7B提供了最清楚的案例。
图5(a)显示2,600 2{,}600个视频的预测数的直方图:16个整数出现,其中5个集中了质量的80% 80%:20个(预计716 716次)、30个(628 628次)、50个(373 373次)、12个(224 224次)和10个(124次)。
图4的精确匹配峰值与这5个首选值中的4个相对应: EM为95% 95\%在n=20 n=20,43\%在n=30 n=30,94%94\%在n=50 n=50,87%在n=12 n=12.
第五,10 10 行为不同: 10 10 值在基准上预测为124 124倍,但其中只有 49 49 个预测发生在 n = 10 n = 10,因此 EM = 10 n = 10 停留在 49 % 49 = .
在首选套件以外的每一个基本值上,模型都回落到最接近的首选值上,这在构造上是不正确的;整个基准中从未预测值为4040,因此,在n=40n=40时,EM=0=0。
因此,精确匹配峰值标志着一组小型的、针对模型的首选答案与地面真实值之间的巧合,而不是模型中最关键的值。
图4显示了AdaReTake-7B、InternVL2.5-8B和NVILA-8B的同一峰值和折叠结构,各有各自的首选组合。

blocks.en:
Perplexity reveals a narrow effective vocabulary. Table 2 quantifies this concentration of mass across all evaluated models.
The Oracle row gives the reference values of a model that would predict the ground truth on every video: support equal to the twenty-six benchmark cardinalities, perplexity equal to twenty-six as well.
VideoLLaMA2-7B sits at the opposite end of the table ( | 𝒮 | = 5 |\mathcal{S}|=5 , PP = 1.1 \mathrm{PP}=1.1 ); these values reflect its near-zero coverage rather than a value-dependent bias.
Twelve of the fifteen non-degenerate models stay well below the Oracle reference, with support between sixteen and thirty-two distinct integer answers and perplexity below 18 18 .
Four have perplexity below 10 10 : InternVL2.5-78B ( 5.9 5.9 ), LLaVA-Video-7B ( 8.0 8.0 ), VideoLLaMA2-72B ( 8.9 8.9 ), and InternVL2.5-8B ( 9.4 9.4 ).
These models effectively answer the benchmark with the equivalent of fewer than ten equally-frequent values, against twenty-six target cardinalities. blocks.en:
High perplexity does not imply uniformity. The diversity reported in Table 2 does not imply uniformity.
Figure 5 (b)–(c) plots the histograms of predicted counts for the two proprietary models, which sit at the top of the perplexity column.
Both distributions exhibit pronounced local irregularities.
For GPT-5.4, the largest local excess across its support is observed at value 39 39 , with + 126 +126 predictions above its neighbours, and the largest local deficit at value 30 30 , a benchmark anchor cardinality, with − 114 -114 predictions below its flanking peaks. Gemini-3.1-pro shows the same qualitative pattern with smaller amplitudes: maximum local excess of + 53 +53 at value 36 36 , maximum local deficit of − 57 -57 at value 27 27 .
The aggregate perplexity therefore captures only the global spread of the prediction distribution, not its local structure: even a model with PP > 30 \mathrm{PP}>30 can concentrate its predictions on isolated values and avoid others, including benchmark anchor cardinalities.
The same kind of local structure is visible in the histograms of the remaining models, shown in Appendix Figs. 8 – 15 .

blocks.en: The biases documented in this section are visible only because every cardinality in [ 5 , 50 ] [5,50] contributes the same number of videos. On an imbalanced benchmark, the per-cardinality peaks, the Coverage–EM dissociation, and the local excesses and deficits of the prediction histograms would all be absorbed into the dominant counts, conflating response policy, output diversity, and value-dependent biases into a single aggregate score. The structure persists across three prompt formulations on three models and is not explained by object class, though absolute accuracy varies with both (Appendices E and F ).

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
This paper introduced CountVideoBench, a balanced benchmark of 2,600 2{,}600 synthetic videos covering 26 26 cardinalities in the range [ 5 , 50 ] [5,50] with 100 100 videos per cardinality, organized in an anchor-neighborhood structure that combines a broad cardinality range with the local resolution needed to compare neighboring counts.
Sixteen video-language models from nine architecture families were considered.
A multi-criteria evaluation is proposed using a single zero-shot protocol.
Three findings emerged from the analysis.
No model exceeds 27.6 % 27.6\% Exact Match on a task involving a single object class, static instances, and a controlled camera motion: counting remains unresolved even after recognition and object motion have been removed as confounds.
The dependence of model behavior on cardinality is not a simple difficulty-driven decay (trajectories along the cardinality axis vary across models, either declining monotonically or following a non-monotonic peak-and-collapse structure). Coverage degradation, when it occurs, joins this decay rather than offsetting it through selective abstention.
Every model concentrates its predictions on its own set of preferred integer values, with accuracy peaks coinciding with these values and collapsing at adjacent counts.
In most models, predictions are confined to a small set of values; in those with the broadest output distributions, the concentration appears instead as pronounced local irregularities.
blocks.zh:
本文引入了Bench伯爵(Count Video Bench),平衡的基准为2,600 2{,}600个合成视频,涵盖范围为[5,50] [5,50] 的26个基本点,每个基本点为100个主要点,以锚-邻结构排列,将广泛的基本点范围与比较邻里计数所需的本地分辨率相结合.

分析得出三项结论。
无型号超过27.6% 27.6%*= 精确匹配任务涉及单个对象类,静态实例,以及受控相机运动:即使在识别和物体运动被移除为混乱后,计数仍未解决.
模型行为对基质的依赖性并不是简单的由难度驱动的衰变(基质轴沿导体的导体因模型而异,要么单调下降,要么遵循非模态的峰值-和-缩合结构). 发生退化时,覆盖率下降会加入这种衰减,而不是通过选择性弃权来抵消。
每个模型将其预测集中在自己的一组首选整数值上,精度高峰与这些值相吻合,并在相邻的计数时崩溃.
在大多数模型中,预测仅限于一小组数值;在产出分布最广的模型中,集中显示为明显的当地违规行为。

blocks.en:
These observations could not be characterized on the cardinality distributions of existing Video-QA benchmarks, where aggregate scores conflate response policy, output diversity, and value-dependent biases into a single number.
The balanced design of CountVideoBench makes the underlying structure visible without resolving its origin.
The design suggests several extensions.
Adding distractor object classes would measure the cost of reintroducing recognition under the same counting protocol; introducing object motion would extend the analysis to temporal tracking and accumulation.
The balanced-distribution principle could also be applied beyond the synthetic regime, to natural video, and transposed to other VideoQA dimensions where similar value-dependent biases may remain hidden behind imbalanced distributions: attribute recognition, action enumeration, and temporal estimation.
blocks.zh:
这些看法不能以现有Video-QA基准的主要分布为特征,即总分将反应政策、产出多样性和依赖价值的偏差合并成一个数字。
平衡的Video Bench伯爵的设计使得基础结构显眼而不解决其起源.
设计建议了几个扩展.
增加分散对象类别将测量根据同一计数协议重新进行识别的成本;引入对象运动将分析扩大到时间跟踪和积累。
平衡分布原则也可适用于合成系统以外的自然视频,并移植到VideoQA的其他维度,其中类似的基于价值的偏差可能仍然隐藏在分布不平衡的背后:属性识别、动作计数和时间估计。

Object placement. Object positions are sampled in the plane z = 0 z=0 rather than in a volume.
The admissible region is the intersection of the camera frustum with that plane, scaled by a factor 0.9 0.9 about its centroid so that no object is placed exactly at the edge of the initial field of view.
Positions are drawn by uniform rejection sampling within the bounding box of this region, retaining a candidate only if it lies inside the region and is at least 3 3 units away from every previously accepted position.
The sampler always produces 60 60 valid positions and retains the first N N , so the packing problem is identical at every cardinality: the objects of a video with N = 5 N=5 occupy the same region, under the same separation constraint, as those of a video with N = 50 N=50 .
Increasing difficulty with cardinality therefore does not arise from a tightening of the scene geometry.

Separation and non-overlap. The minimum separation of 3 3 units is enforced on the sampled positions, before the planar jitter of ± 0.30 \pm 0.30 (cubes) or ± 0.25 \pm 0.25 (spheres) is applied.

These cases are resolved by the rigid-body solver: the physics cache is baked before rendering, and objects come to rest during the settling window that precedes the recorded frames.

blocks.en: Section 6.1 reports that no model exceeds 27.6 % 27.6\% Exact Match on CountVideoBench. Two readings of this number are possible: either the models fail at a task that is solvable, or the scenes themselves are too dense or too briefly observed to be counted exactly. We ran a human study to separate them.

blocks.en:
Participants. Twenty volunteers took part, without compensation.
They were told only to count the objects of the specified class as accurately as they could; the purpose of the study, the cardinality range, and the existence of a model comparison were not disclosed. Participation could be interrupted at any point.
All twenty completed the full protocol, giving a fully crossed design in which every participant answers every video, so that participant ability and video difficulty are not confounded.

与会者。 20名志愿者参加,没有补偿.
他们只被告知尽可能准确地计算特定类别的对象;没有披露研究的目的、主要范围以及是否存在模型比较。 参与可随时中断。
全部20人完成了完整的协议,给出了一个完全跨度的设计,每个参与者在其中回答每一个视频,这样参与者的能力和视频难度就不会被混淆.

blocks.en:
Stimuli. We sampled 104 104 videos, four per cardinality across the 26 26 values of the benchmark, drawn at random within each cardinality under a constraint keeping the ten object classes close to balanced overall.
Participants viewed exactly the ten uniformly sampled frames given to the models throughout the paper, presented as a playable sequence; the full 150 150 -frame clip was not available to them.
Playback was unconstrained: participants could pause, step back, and take as long as they wished. Each video was answered with a single integer, and no answer could be skipped.

All rows of Table 4 , human and model alike, are computed over the same 104 104 videos.
We additionally report a majority-vote aggregate, in which each video receives the modal answer of the twenty participants.

blocks.en:
Accuracy. Mean human Exact Match reaches 90.8 % 90.8\% , against 26.9 % 26.9\% for the best models on this subset (Gemini-3.1-pro and LLaVA-Video-7B).
Per-participant accuracy ranges from 71.2 % 71.2\% to 100.0 % 100.0\% (median 91.8 91.8 , standard deviation 8.1 8.1 ), so the gap is not carried by a subset of strong counters: the weakest participant remains far above the best model. Two participants answered all 104 104 videos correctly, and the majority-vote aggregate is exact on every video. No scene in the subset is therefore intrinsically ambiguous, and the low model scores reflect limitations of current approaches rather than uncountable inputs.

blocks.en: Three models were evaluated on all three: InternVL2.5-8B, LLaVA-Video-7B and NVILA-15B. Each of the nine combinations covers the full set of 2,600 2{,}600 videos under identical conditions (same ten sampled frames, same decoding settings, same answer-extraction procedure), so that the prompt is the only varying factor.
blocks.zh: 对所有三个模型都进行了评价:InternVL2.5-8B、LLaVA-Video-7B和NVILA-15B。 9个组合中每个组合都覆盖了在相同条件下的完整2,600 2{,}600个视频集(相同的10个样本框,相同的解码设置,相同的解答-提取程序),因此提示是唯一不同因素.

blocks.en: Aggregate performance varies without a common direction. Table 5 reports the metrics of Section 5.2 for the nine combinations. Exact Match spans 10.1 10.1 – 19.0 % 19.0\% for InternVL2.5-8B, 18.7 18.7 – 26.8 % 26.8\% for LLaVA-Video-7B and 7.3 7.3 – 12.5 % 12.5\% for NVILA-15B. No formulation is uniformly preferable: P3 is the best of the three for InternVL2.5-8B and the worst for the other two models. The prompt used in the paper is therefore not one selected for favourable results, and aggregate scores are sensitive to wording in a model-dependent way.
blocks.zh: 总体性能不同,没有共同的方向. 表5报告了第5.2节对9种组合的衡量尺度。 准确的Match跨度为10.1 – 19.0 % 19.0% 19.0% InternVL2.5-8B,18.7 18.7 – 26.8% 26.8% LLaVA-Video-7B,7.3 7.3 – 12.5% 12.5% NVILA-15B. 没有一个配方是统一可取的:P3是InternVL2.5-8B的三种配方中最好的,其他两种配方最差. 因此,文件中所用的速率不是为取得有利结果而选择的,总得分对措词具有依赖模型的敏感性。

blocks.en: The cardinality profile remains structured. Figure 16 shows Exact Match against ground-truth count for the nine combinations. All of them exhibit the same structure: isolated peaks at a small number of cardinalities, surrounded by collapses at adjacent values.

blocks.en: Limitations. The study covers three formulations on three models under a single decoding configuration. It establishes that the reported structure is not specific to the wording of P1, not that it is invariant to every possible instruction or sampling strategy.
